title: An account created by a native Stellar Asset Contract transfer produces no account_created

target.versions_affected: e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967 (range not established); also 3e22515a (checked 2026-11-13); also 18db88f4 (replay 2026-11-19); also f0c00cf5 (replay 2026-11-20)

severity_basis: An account created by a native Stellar Asset Contract transfer (CAP-73) produces no account_created state change; the other facts of the transaction match. The same class as issue #731 (a SAC call creating a trustline), fixed upstream for trustlines. Executed through the replay harness on both inputs; the baseline indexer reports the change.

entries.expected: an account_created state change for the account the transfer creates
entries.observed: Executed at e967ce8b through the replay harness (make replay-full), both inputs, on all four variants (Protocols 29 and 30, testnet and pubnet passphrases): dropped · partial, no account_created for GBPRDIGX…; every other compared fact matched.

entries.expected: an account_created state change for the account the transfer creates
entries.observed: Executed at e967ce8b through the replay harness (make replay-full), both inputs, on the stellar-core v30.0.0 golden (frame 17, ledger 19, transaction 88f25cc7…): dropped · partial, no account_created for GBMZAFOQ…; every other compared fact matched.

evidence.pre_fix: make replay-full (the whole corpus against wallet-backend at the pinned current commit e967ce8b, both inputs): dropped · partial on the four variants of cap-0073/native-sac-transfer-creates-account-local-twins and on the stellar-core golden of the same case, cap-0073/native-sac-transfer-creates-account. Still reproduces at 3e22515a.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-73 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/f2d364902615af726b3533021403c8b225aa6e5d/core/cap-0073.md): a native (XLM) Stellar Asset Contract transfer to a G-address that does not exist creates the account; the operation's ledger meta shows the ACCOUNT entry created.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record: the account creation was missing again as recorded, offline. Reproduced again at 3e22515a on both inputs before filing.

approval.scope: Public issue on stellar/wallet-backend (#804): a native SAC transfer that creates an account produces no ACCOUNT/CREATE and no SIGNER state change.

history.note: Created from the replay run's failure rows; no public upstream item found.
Reproduced, upstream searched (none found), issue text written; awaiting a maintainer's review before filing.

Filed by the maintainers of this kit as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/804 at main 3e22515a, reproduced on the stellar-core v30.0.0 golden test-lcm-current/InvokeHostFunctionTests/692fdd0e57531ce4.xdr frame 17 (ledger 19, transaction 88f25cc7…).

The wallet-backend adapter no longer declares an account_created caused by a contract call out of scope (it had excused the golden, which passed); the golden cap-0073/native-sac-transfer-creates-account now fails dropped · partial at e967ce8b on both inputs and is added to the entries and report rows. No other row changed.
